assumptions.statement: Closing the 6% electronics price gap to the main competitor keeps electronics volume flat (no elasticity data in sources); sizing: +€17M gross profit on €290M, ≈ +0.9 pp group gross margin
assumptions.sensitivity: If only half the gap is closed, ≈ +0.4 pp
assumptions.validation: Price test on top 200 references, Q1 2027

assumptions.statement: Restoring FY2024 margin rates in grocery (+0.5 pp) and apparel (+1.0 pp) on FY2025 revenue adds ≈ €4.5M gross profit, ≈ +0.3 pp
If electronics grows 25% as budgeted at 11.5% margin with other categories flat, group gross margin falls a further ≈ 0.7 pp (to ≈ 25.7%)
Freight is booked in operating costs, below gross margin, so freight savings improve EBIT, not gross margin
